text:
To,
The Executive Engineer,
Sub: Persistent leakage, Saraswathipuram

Sir, on behalf of the Saraswathipuram Residents' Welfare Association I wish to report that the main pipe below the 8th Cross road, between the Ramakrishna Ashram and the milk dairy, has been leaking for about three weeks. Initially it was only a wet patch, now water flows openly near the dairy during the morning supply. The road has a depression of almost 6 inches. We request urgent repair.

Secretary, SRWA
sum: Main under 8th Cross, Saraswathipuram leaking for three weeks between the ashram and the dairy; road sunk 6 inches.

text: Caller (Mr. ___, retired) from Vijayanagar 2nd stage reports: water collects every morning at the corner of 9th main near the RTO office. He says he walked up the slope and found the ground wet near the valve chamber on 10th main, opposite the girls' school. He has seen this for about 10 days. No water inside his house is affected.
sum: Water collects each morning at 9th Main near the RTO office; wet ground near a valve chamber up on 10th Main opposite the girls' school.

text: Hello. I run a small clinic on Sampige Road (Dr. Rao's Clinic, opposite Mantri Mall). For a week, the footpath outside has been permanently damp and last night there was a distinct hissing noise from the chamber in front of the clinic. My own meter is not moving when taps are off. Please send someone to check before the footpath collapses.
sum: Footpath outside a clinic on Sampige Road opposite Mantri Mall damp for a week, hissing from the chamber; own meter steady.

text: THREAD 1/3: Since Sunday there's water flowing down Bull Temple Road from near the Dodda Ganapathi temple to the Gandhi Bazaar circle. 2/3: It's clear water, not drain. 3/3: Our house supply also became weak. @BWSSB_official please check
sum: Clear water flows down Bull Temple Road from Dodda Ganapathi temple to Gandhi Bazaar circle since Sunday; weaker house supply.

text: Repeat complainant. First call: damp ground outside house no 112, Sector 3. Today: says the damp area has grown to the neighbour's gate (114) and there is now a small trickle towards the drain. Says it never dries, even at 2 pm.
sum: Damp ground outside 112, Sector 3 has spread to number 114 with a trickle to the drain; never dries.

text:
Dear Sir/Madam,
I am writing regarding the water stagnation outside our apartment, Pearl Residency, Kammanahalli main road. Initially we thought it was rain water but there has been no rain for 12 days. The water is clear, and appears every night and dries partly by afternoon. Our association checked our sump and overhead tanks; there is no overflow. Kindly investigate the municipal line.
sum: Clear water appears nightly outside Pearl Residency on Kammanahalli main road without rain for 12 days; own tanks checked.

text: Update on my complaint: the water near the SBI on Residency Road that I said was a leak — today the shop next door told me it is the overflow of their sintex tank. BUT the hissing sound under the road at night is still there and that is not the tank (tank fills only in morning).
sum: Water near SBI on Residency Road was a shop's tank overflow, but the night hissing under the road remains.

text: Complaint about Chord Road: there is a long crack along the centre of the road from the petrol bunk to the Navarang theatre junction, about 50 metres. In the mornings the crack is wet and there is a slight sound of running water if you stand near the manhole by the theatre.
sum: 50 m wet crack along Chord Road from the petrol bunk to Navarang theatre, with running water audible near a manhole.

text: Caller from HAL 2nd stage says: 'For two days the water in our lane is coming brown in the morning and there is also a pool near the 12th main bus stop. Is it connected?' Pool is clear water, caller says.
sum: Brown morning water in a HAL 2nd Stage lane for two days and a clear pool near the 12th Main bus stop.

text:
Subject: Sinkhole risk, Nanjappa Circle
Respected Sir,
The road near Nanjappa Circle, in front of Bhagyalakshmi Jewellers, has been sinking slowly over the last month. Shopkeepers have noticed water seeping from the edges of the depression early in the morning. Yesterday a two-wheeler skidded. We fear a cave-in. Please act before an accident.
sum: Road sinking in front of Bhagyalakshmi Jewellers at Nanjappa Circle for a month, water seeping at the edges.

text: PSA for @WaterBoardHelp — the 'leak' at 3rd cross that got 20 retweets is a burst on the private line of the new mall construction (I asked the guards). The REAL problem is the damp road 200m down near the mosque which has been there 3 weeks
sum: Viral leak on 3rd Cross is a private construction line; separate damp road near the mosque 200 m away for three weeks.

text: Caller: Shopkeeper at the KR Puram railway station road. Says since the metro work began, every morning the service lane near the auto stand floods with clean water around 5-7 am, then drains away. On Sunday when supply is off, it was dry.
sum: Service lane near the auto stand on KR Puram station road floods with clean water during morning supply since metro work; dry on Sunday.

text:
Dear Water Board,
This is regarding complaint no. 88213. The crew came on Tuesday, dug near the electric pole on Mill Road and found nothing. However the water is still coming out about 30 metres further towards the old flour mill. Please send them back to the correct spot.
sum: After a dry dig near the pole on Mill Road, water still comes out 30 m further towards the old flour mill.

text: Our society (Brindavan Gardens Phase 1) has had low pressure since last Thursday. At the same time there is a lot of water flowing in the storm drain along the main road even though it is dry season. Could a main be leaking into the drain?
sum: Low pressure in Brindavan Gardens Phase 1 since Thursday and dry-season flow in the storm drain along the main road.

text: Caller from Jalahalli: 'Near the bus depot gate, there is a spot where the soil keeps washing away and you can see a pipe. Water is dripping from the pipe joint.' Has been there since the rains stopped, about 2 weeks.
sum: Exposed pipe joint dripping where soil washes away near the Jalahalli bus depot gate for two weeks.

text: Since 3 weeks the corner outside 'Hotel Dwaraka' Gandhi Nagar has a dark wet patch + green moss, AND the hotel says their pipes are fine. Neighbour heard hissing at 1am. Smells like chlorine not sewage. Classic hidden leak?
sum: Wet mossy patch outside Hotel Dwaraka in Gandhi Nagar for three weeks; hissing at night; chlorine smell.

text: Hello, I am a teacher at Government Higher Primary School, Ulsoor. The playground near the boundary wall facing the lake road has become marshy and children are falling. The headmistress says there is no tap there. It started after the road work on Lake Road last month.
since: after the road work on Lake Road last month
sum: School playground at Ulsoor near the Lake Road wall has become marshy since road work last month; no tap there.

text: Caller says there is a leak but cannot say exactly where: 'somewhere between the temple and the water tank on our road, the whole stretch is wet'. Area: Ganganagar.
sum: Stretch between the temple and the water tank in Ganganagar is wet; exact spot unknown.

text: Dear team, two complaints from Rose Garden Layout: (a) the drain on 2nd Cross is choked and smells, (b) separately, clear water is bubbling up near the transformer on 3rd Cross. Please do not treat both as drainage.
sum: Rose Garden Layout: choked drain on 2nd Cross, and separately clear water bubbling near the transformer on 3rd Cross.

text: Okay so at 11pm the road outside Bangalore Central (Residency Rd) is dry, at 6am there's a stream. Every day. That's not rain. That's the morning supply escaping 🤷
sum: Road outside Bangalore Central on Residency Road has a stream every morning but is dry at night.

text: Woman caller from Shivajinagar says her neighbour told her the water on the road near Russell Market is from a broken municipal pipe. Caller has not seen it herself; she is reporting on behalf of the neighbour.
sum: Second-hand report of a broken municipal pipe near Russell Market in Shivajinagar.

text:
Sir,
I live on the first floor at 23/4, 1st Main, Seshadripuram. For the last 4 nights I have heard a continuous sound of water from the road below between midnight and 4 am. During the day there is nothing visible. My downstairs neighbour says her floor near the front door is damp.
sum: Continuous night water sound under the road at 23/4, 1st Main, Seshadripuram for four nights; neighbour's floor damp.

text: There is a major leak at the junction of Hennur Main Road and Kalyan Nagar 80 ft road, near the HDFC bank. It started this morning around 8. Traffic police have put barricades. The water is about 6 inches deep at the signal.
sum: Major leak at Hennur Main Road and Kalyan Nagar 80 Feet Road near HDFC Bank since 8 am; water 6 inches deep.

text: Caller says the water standing in front of his gate is from the hill side, but he also says the tap pressure in his house has been low for a week. Address: 7, Upper Hill Road. Note: low pressure alone is not leak evidence.
sum: Water standing at 7 Upper Hill Road comes from the hill side; low tap pressure for a week.

text: @MunicipalCorp the leak you 'fixed' on Nov 12 at Ashok Pillar is back since Thursday. Same spot, same fountain. Photo attached. Ticket #55921
sum: Leak at Ashok Pillar repaired on 12 November is back at the same spot since Thursday.

text:
Respected Sir,
Water has been entering the basement of Sri Venkateshwara Temple on Temple Road for 5 days. The temple's pipes have been checked by a plumber and are fine. The seepage is from the wall facing the road, where the municipal main runs.
sum: Water entering the basement of Sri Venkateshwara Temple from the road-side wall for five days; temple pipes fine.

text: Caller from Kumara Park: reports there was no water for two days and now that it has come back, there is a fountain from the footpath near the Kumara Krupa guest house. Probably burst when pressure returned.
sum: After two days without water, a fountain from the footpath near Kumara Krupa guest house in Kumara Park.

text: Complaint re: dampness. The lower walls of all the houses on the east side of 4th Cross, Malleswaram (nos 21 to 31) are damp from the road side. The west side houses are dry. The main line runs on the east side.
sum: Lower walls of houses 21-31 on the east side of 4th Cross, Malleswaram damp from the road side where the main runs.

text: Heads up — big pool of water on Old Airport Road near HAL museum since morning, cars splashing pedestrians. Not sure if leak or drain, no smell though
sum: Big odourless pool on Old Airport Road near the HAL museum since morning; leak or drain unclear.

text: Caller from RMV extension says he heard a loud bang at about 3 am and now water is flowing down the road from the direction of Sadashivanagar police station. He has not gone close.
sum: Loud bang at 3 am in RMV Extension; water now flowing down from the Sadashivanagar police station direction.

text:
Dear Sir,
This is to inform you that the residents of Lakshmi Road are facing frequent pipe bursts at the same place in front of house no. 64 — three times in two months. Each time it is patched. Perhaps the whole section needs replacement.
sum: Repeated bursts at the same spot in front of 64 Lakshmi Road, three times in two months.

text: The damp patch reported last week near Canara Bank, 3rd Block, has now become a small pit with water. The tiles around are loose. Also someone has put a stone to mark it.
sum: Damp patch near Canara Bank in 3rd Block has become a small water-filled pit with loose tiles.

text: Complainant: 'There are two leaks, one near the masjid on Tannery Road and one near the church on the same road, 300 m apart.' Both visible, clean water.
sum: Two visible clean-water leaks on Tannery Road, near the masjid and near the church, 300 m apart.

text: My building's watchman says the hissing near the gate at night is 'normal pipe sound'. It wasn't there last month. Prestige Shantiniketan gate 3. Wet patch too.
sum: New night hissing and a wet patch at Prestige Shantiniketan gate 3.

text:
Subject: Flooding of shop basement, Commercial Street
We run Arora Textiles at 45 Commercial Street. Since Monday, water seeps into our basement every morning around 6 am and stops by 10 am. It is clean water. There is no rain and our tanks are on the terrace. We suspect the corporation line on the road.
sum: Clean water seeps into the basement at 45 Commercial Street between 6 and 10 am since Monday; tanks on the terrace.

text: Caller corrected the location: it's not near the Shiva temple on Sai Baba Road, it is near the Shiva temple on Temple Street, 2 km away. Water coming out of the road there.
sum: Water coming out of the road near the Shiva temple on Temple Street (corrected location).

text: I am an engineer living in Whitefield. The road outside Forum Value Mall has a characteristic leak sign: a strip of darker asphalt, always wet, along the line where the pipe was laid last year. I can also hear a faint hiss through a screwdriver on the valve cap at night.
sum: Always-wet strip along last year's pipe line outside Forum Value Mall in Whitefield, with a faint hiss at the valve at night.

text: 3 days of a geyser-like spray at the BMTC depot Shanthinagar entrance. Buses driving through it. Someone pls close the valve.
sum: Spray like a geyser at the BMTC depot entrance in Shanthinagar for three days.

text: Caller states water is leaking from the pipe inside the compound of the vacant house next door (no. 17, Sankey Road). Nobody lives there. Water flows out to the street.
sum: Pipe leaking inside the compound of vacant house 17 on Sankey Road, water flowing to the street.

text: Dear Sir, the area near Hebbal lake, behind the Esteem Mall, has had a puddle for the past month that does not dry. The ground nearby is soft. Kindly check whether it is a leaking pipe or lake seepage.
sum: Puddle behind Esteem Mall near Hebbal lake has not dried for a month; soft ground; pipe or lake seepage unclear.
